name: Hit the Floor! Third
source:
Are you ready to find out what we have in store for you and Ken this time?
Well, we can only tell you that the two of you are going on holidays.
Luxurious hotel, romantic dinner, swimming pool…
Hope you'll enjoy it

[From official site]
